Is Mon 2 Nov a holiday in Mumbai?
8:31 PM

No, as far as I know Mon 2 Nov was a normal working day in Mumbai, with no public or bank holiday. It was also 10 days ago, so I can't confirm it from a live list. Diwali this year fell around Sun 8 Nov.
